title: Region canonicalization: merge near-duplicate regions, fix garbled region names, hierarchy hygiene
description: Regions grew 642→900 across enrichment rounds and accumulated near-duplicates and artifacts: e.g. 'West Palm Beach' vs 'West Palm Beach, FL' (marina:safe-harbor-rybovich has 3 located_in edges to near-dupe regions), garbled node 'Palm Beach; often grouped with Fort Lauderdale…' (prose as region name), 'Barcelona' vs 'Barcelona, Catalonia' granularity variants. Build a region-canonicalization pass in the ingest pipeline: normalize 'City, ST'/'City' variants onto one canonical node, quarantine prose-name artifacts, dedupe located_in/based_in edges after merge, and harden regions.js resolution so future rounds stop minting variants (the TASK-020 word-overlap compatibility check is a starting point — make canonicalization the mapper-level default). Data-driven merge map with rationale, same discipline as graphCleanup. No web research needed — this is programmatic + judgment over the existing 900 names.
acceptance_criteria: A region canonicalization step runs in the pipeline with a documented merge map; near-duplicate city variants merged (spot-checks: one West Palm Beach, one Barcelona)
Prose-name region artifacts identified and quarantined/renamed with rationale; no region node whose name contains ';' or sentence fragments
No node carries duplicate located_in edges to merged regions; orphan-edge scan clean; all non-region type counts unchanged
regions.js resolution hardened so re-ingesting the same corpus mints zero new variant regions (idempotency test)
All tests green, pins updated deliberately, score delta recorded (region connectivity should improve)

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED on green review (PASS, all 5 ACs met — AC2 under its quarantine disjunction: one ';' name survives deliberately as artifact:true for a relocation-history node where any single place would be a guess). Regions 900→857 (arithmetic verified by enumeration: -35 Tier-1 alias collapses, -8 Tier-2 merges, -2 renames), edges 2621→2613, part_of preserved +2 correct Florida roll-ups, 748+124 tests, score 6.80 unchanged (region was connectivity-saturated — win is query correctness: WPB/Barcelona unified). Carry-forwards to TASK-023: (1) MEDIUM: split region:naples into Naples FL / Naples Italy and re-point the Naples (HQ) alias to the Italy node (Palumbo shipyards are grounded Italian; FL clubs grounded Florida); (2) HIGH-priority first item: fix the pre-existing double-ingest bug where YACHT_QUALITY_CORRECTIONS loa rewrites cause yachtMapper to mint eiv-2/mystere-2 siblings on re-ingest — MUST be fixed before TASK-023 adds ~15 more corrections through the same mechanism. Backlog: region:newport OR/RI conflation, club-abbreviation regions (byc/syc/cyca), compound descriptors, artifact:true UI badge.
